methodology: Microsoft Intelligent Cloud segment revenue and operating income, mapped from Microsoft fiscal quarters to calendar quarters by quarter-end date. Fiscal Q4 quarterly values are derived from annual segment totals less reported nine-month cumulative totals where the earnings-release table does not provide a standalone quarter. Intelligent Cloud includes Azure and other cloud services, server products and enterprise/partner services; it is not an Azure-only or AI-only metric.

limitations: Microsoft fiscal quarters are mapped to calendar quarters by their quarter-end dates; FY2024 Q1 ended September 30, 2023 and is calendar 2023-Q3.
Intelligent Cloud includes Azure and other cloud services, server products, and enterprise/partner services. It is not Azure-only revenue, nor AI-only revenue or profit.

FY2023 Q4, FY2024 Q4 and FY2025 Q4 quarterly values are arithmetic differences between reported annual segment totals and reported nine-month cumulative segment totals. The source URLs for both inputs are retained.

Segment disclosures may be recast in later reports. The series retains the original period-specific report values and should be reviewed for accounting presentation changes before statistical inference.
No missing quarter has been interpolated.
